about_pullquote: We started in Hull because locals deserve fair prices and honest advice, not sales patter.
about_para_1: D.L.S. Plumbing, Heating & Gas has been serving Hull homes and businesses for over 15 years. We specialise in central heating installation, repair, and maintenance, with Gas Safe registration and a track record of 800+ completed jobs. Our engineers live locally and understand the heating needs of East Yorkshire properties.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up on time, fixing faults quickly, and never overcharging. Most customers call us back because we explain what's wrong without the jargon, and we always offer a fair price before we start work. Many of our jobs come from word-of-mouth recommendations—that's how we like it.
reviews_heading: What Hull Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: My boiler packed in just before Christmas and I was panicking. Called D.L.S. at 6pm and they sent someone out the same evening. Mark was brilliant—diagnosed a faulty pump, fixed it in under an hour, and didn't charge us the earth like some firms would've. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had our old boiler replaced last month. The lads were professional, tidy, explained everything clearly, and finished on time. The new boiler is so much quieter and our bills are already dropping. Great job and fair pricing.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency radiator leak at the weekend and they came out within 90 minutes. Really impressed with the service. No messing about, just fixed it properly. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Robert H.
